summary: Filings search must identify its announcements-only corpus and preserve warnings in agent JSON even when the search scan is complete.
reason: PSE EDGE search can omit disclosures available through the viewer. Preserve bounded-scan documentation and direct edge_no recovery so empty or complete search results cannot imply corpus completeness. This is PSE-specific porcelain behavior.
validated_outcome: Agent serialization covers full, empty, capped, and limited searches; direct lookup requests only openDiscViewer.do.
